RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, November 30, 2011/Agrahayana 9, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs; Housing
and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Labour and Employment; Textiles;
Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Increasing  dependency of
manufacturing sector on import from
China
†*121. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
75 per cent of India's manufacturing would
be dependent on goods imported from
China by 2014-15;
(b) whether the National Security
Council of the country has expressed
concern over the increasing dependency
over China;
(c) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to make domestic industries
self-dependent and to end the dependency
upon China;
(d) the percentage of export and import
between India and China and the profit
earned by China annually out of it; and
(e) the steps being taken by Government
to bring parity in import and export?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Reduction in customs duty for import
of dry rubber
*122. DR. T. N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
withdraw the permission given to import
dry rubber at reduced rate of customs duty;
and
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to protect the interests of rubber farmers,
in view of the steep fall in demand and price
of natural rubber?
Wear and tear of Delhi Metro lines
*123. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the lines of the Delhi Metro which
have maximum wear and tear;
(b) the reasons therefor and the
corrective action taken in the matter;
(c) the lines of Delhi Metro which are
most zigzag;

38
(d) what are its implications; and
(e) in what way it will be remedied?
Steps to alleviate poverty from urban
areas
*124. SHRI TARUN VIJAY: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of deaths in the country
in the poorer sections of the society due to
malnutrition and starvation and the
immediate steps taken by Government to
tackle the situation;
(b) the steps taken during the last one
year to alleviate poverty from urban areas
and the results thereof; and
(c) the number of poor families in urban
sector and the quantum of their daily food
intake?
Steps to ensure minimum wages to
menial workers
*125. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in Delhi and
other cities, liftmen, sweepers and other
menial workers are not getting minimum
wages;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether contract labourers are
mainly responsible for this situation; and
(d) if so, the measures Government
proposes to take, to ensure minimum
wages, at least in the National Capital?
Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor
*126. SHRI PIYUSH GOYAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has given its
final approval for Delhi-Mumbai Industrial
Corridor;
(b) if so, the details thereof and financial
burden which Government is expected to
bear and the time-frame for completion of
the proposed project;
(c) whether the expenditure is being
shared by the Central and the State
Governments, if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the project is being funded
by external/non-Governmental sources;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the reasons for undertaking this
project?
Fencing of defence land in UP and
MP
†*127. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the area of land held by the army in
border areas of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya
Pradesh, particularly in Mahoba and
Chhatarpur districts;
(b) whether villagers are still cultivating
and their cattle are grazing on the defence
land and construction work is also going
on there;
(c) whether there is any plan to fence
the defence land by getting the firing range
vacated in village Dhorra in the district of
Mahoba; and
(d) if so, by when the villagers will be
provided with an alternate thoroughfare
and the details thereof?
Decline in employment growth
*128. SHRI SHYAMAL
CHAKRABORTY: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a substantial decline in employment
growth from 2004-05 to 2009-10;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
slowdown has been most severe in case of
female workers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Incursions by China in J & K
*129. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Jammu and Kashmir has
reported that there are incursions from the
Chinese side in our territory;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government has taken in
this regard?
Setting up of NCTC
*130. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is mulling setting up of a National Counter
Terrorism Centre (NCTC) in the aftermath
of 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when this Centre would be set
up to disrupt, dismantle and eventually
defeat the terrorist groups?
Memorandum on anti-Sikh riots
*131. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether a delegation of leaders of
some political parties submitted a
memorandum to Prime Minister in New
Delhi, recently, on anti-Sikh riots of 1984;
(b) if so, the details of the
memorandum; and
(c) the action taken by Government
thereon?
Rehabilitation of child labourers
†*132. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the schemes under which Central
Government provides aid for the
rehabilitation of child labourers;
(b) whether Government proposes to
rehabilitate those children who are freed
from child labour under Child Labour
Prohibition  Act and who do not have
parents;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether some financial assistance
is being provided to special schools run by
the NGOs for their rehabilitation;
(e) if so, the details of such NGOs and
the quantum of funds provided to them for
this purpose during  last three years; and
(f) the standards/parameters followed
by Government to define inclusion of such
children into mainstream of formal
education?
Development of civic amenities in cities
of Maharashtra
†*133. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has not yet
sanctioned the proposal sent by
Maharashtra Government for development
of civic amenities in 91 small and medium
cities of the State under the Central
Scheme, in the year 2010-11;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

40
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
expedite allocation of funds by according
approval to this proposal; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Approval of Metro rail projects
*134. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) how many Metro rail projects have
been approved by Government;
(b) the details of the projects, including
Central funding to each and every approved
Metro project;
(c) whether Government has given
approval to Kochi Metro project; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Dalits killed in police firing in Tamil
Nadu
†*135. SHRI RAM VILAS PASWAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that six dalits
were killed in police firing in Parmakudi
village, Ramnathpuram of Tamil Nadu in
the month of September; and
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government against guilty officers and the
assistance provided to the families of
deceased?
Impact of removal of import duties on
knitwear
*136. DR. K.P. RAMALINGAM: Will
the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
remove 61 items, including 48 readymade
garments, from the list of protected goods
and thus to allow Bangladesh to export to
our country readymade garments, duty free;
(b) if so, whether such removal of
import duties on knitwear would adversally
impact on the textile belts in Tirupur of
Tamil Nadu, which provides employment
to lakhs of people; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Unsolved terror attacks
*137. SHRI PRAKASH
JA V ADEKAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) how many investigations are still
unsolved in the terror acts since 2008;
(b) the details thereof and the reasons
therefor; and
(c) what steps Government has taken
to find the real perpetrators of all these
terror acts?
Rise in encroachment on defence land
†*138. SHRI JAI PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the cases of encroachment on the defence
land in many parts of the country and the
alleged involvement of defence officials in
such cases are on the rise;
(b) if so, the steps being taken to check
such cases; and
(c) the names of cases being
investigated by the CBI or other agencies?
Disposal of mercy petitions
*139. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
30 mercy petitions are pending for disposal;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

41
(b) if so, the details thereof and since
when they are pending;
(c) whether there is any set time-frame
within which they are to be disposed of;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken by Government for
speedy disposal of such mercy petitions?
Help to small tea growers in
Assam
*140. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
more than 30,000 small tea growers in
Assam are facing lots of problems to run
their garden and are not getting actual price
for green tea;
(b) whether Government has taken up
such a serious matter with the Tea Board;
(c) whether Government and Tea Board
have implemented the Tea Marketing
Control Order to determine the actual price
of green tea leaves for the benefit of the
small tea growers;
(d) whether Government will take
initiative to give permission to
establishment of more tea factories to help
small tea growers; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 24th November, 2011 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 3, 1933 (Saka)
